name: enemy_cart
subject: a complete fictional four-wheeled foundry scrap cart for a side-scrolling action game
identity: A compact squat four-wheeled foundry scrap cart, invented 2D action game enemy. Main silhouette 110:75 width to height, strictly facing screen RIGHT. One low asymmetrical burnt-rust-orange mine trolley with charcoal rails, two large dark near-side wheels and two offset darker far-side wheels on the same pair of axles, no fifth wheel. A crushed steel bumper visibly sticks out on the right/front, broad bent industrial plate with no pointed spikes. In its bed are three chunky angular graphite and rust slabs, one tilted. One clearly visible strapped fictional translucent turquoise Haze reservoir with a rigid dark cage band and three clean turquoise tones toward the front, and a squat red warning lamp on top near the right, dark red rim and small bright coral-red lens with a tiny pale highlight so the red palette ramp survives the pixel finish. No literal explosive apparatus, wires, fuses, motor detail, faces, guns, organic characters, numerals, or text.
